knowledge_item_reviewed_has_hash.name: knowledge_item_reviewed_has_hash
knowledge_item_reviewed_has_hash.value: "knowledge_item"."review_status" <> 'reviewed' or ("knowledge_item"."content_hash" is not null and "knowledge_item"."reviewed_at" is not null)

eval_experiment_running_requires_authori.name: eval_experiment_running_requires_authorization
eval_experiment_running_requires_authori.value: "eval_experiment"."status" <> 'running' or ("eval_experiment"."authorized_by" is not null and "eval_experiment"."authorized_at" is not null)

eval_experiment_published_requires_appro.name: eval_experiment_published_requires_approval
eval_experiment_published_requires_appro.value: "eval_experiment"."deployment_status" <> 'published' or ("eval_experiment"."approved_at" is not null and "eval_experiment"."approved_by" is not null)

eval_experiment_rollback_consistency.name: eval_experiment_rollback_consistency
eval_experiment_rollback_consistency.value: "eval_experiment"."deployment_status" <> 'rolled_back' or ("eval_experiment"."rolled_back_at" is not null and "eval_experiment"."rollback_reason" is not null)

experiment_case_result_score_range.name: experiment_case_result_score_range
experiment_case_result_score_range.value: ("experiment_case_result"."baseline_score" is null or "experiment_case_result"."baseline_score" between 0 and 1) and ("experiment_case_result"."candidate_score" is null or "experiment_case_result"."candidate_score" between 0 and 1)

experiment_case_result_exclusion_reason.name: experiment_case_result_exclusion_reason
experiment_case_result_exclusion_reason.value: ("experiment_case_result"."excluded" = false and "experiment_case_result"."exclusion_reason" is null) or ("experiment_case_result"."excluded" = true and char_length(btrim("experiment_case_result"."exclusion_reason")) > 0)

policy_champion_rollback_consistency.name: policy_champion_rollback_consistency
policy_champion_rollback_consistency.value: "policy_champion"."rolled_back_at" is null or ("policy_champion"."rollback_reason" is not null and "policy_champion"."previous_policy_version" is not null)

feedback_entry_message_length.name: feedback_entry_message_length
feedback_entry_message_length.value: "feedback_entry"."message" is null or char_length("feedback_entry"."message") between 1 and 2000

metric_snapshot_ratio_ranges.name: metric_snapshot_ratio_ranges
metric_snapshot_ratio_ranges.value: ("metric_snapshot"."run_failure_rate" is null or "metric_snapshot"."run_failure_rate" between 0 and 1) and ("metric_snapshot"."skill_coverage" is null or "metric_snapshot"."skill_coverage" between 0 and 1) and ("metric_snapshot"."repeat_rate" is null or "metric_snapshot"."repeat_rate" between 0 and 1) and ("metric_snapshot"."plan_adherence" is null or "metric_snapshot"."plan_adherence" between 0 and 1)
